title: LingSante MedGuard Technical Report
abstract_en: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment. Assessing these risks requires checking clinical claims against relevant evidence, verifying calculations, and applying medical requirements under their intended conditions. We introduce LingSante MedGuard, a capability-enhanced guardrail that integrates supervision from a medical guardrail teacher model and six specialized medical capability experts into a unified model. The guardrail teacher supervises risk decisions and explanations across medical safety, compliance, and ethics, while the capability experts support medical rule understanding, numerical reasoning, multimodal hallucination detection, agentic safety verification, risk localization, and multimodal entity understanding. We consolidate these sources of supervision through offline supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated demonstrations, followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation using feedback on student-generated responses. We further introduce LingSante MedGuardBench, a benchmark comprising 11 risk-detection subsets spanning medical safety, compliance, and ethics. At 4B, 9B, and 27B scales, LingSante MedGuard achieves mean benchmark F1 scores of 82.3%, 82.4%, and 87.4%, respectively. The 4B model also achieves 73.9% mean accuracy across MedHallu and MedHALT-NOTA under retrieval-enabled evaluation. Additional evaluations of the verification components show improvements in evidence-supported consistency, source traceability, and rule-guided rationale quality across model scales. These results support the integration of specialized medical capabilities into a unified guardrail for medical risk assessment and evidence-based medical safety verification.
abstract_zh: 随着医疗 AI 用于患者咨询和临床决策支持，识别有害、不合规或违背伦理的回答，需要依据相关证据核验临床陈述、复查计算结果，并判断医疗规则是否适用于当前情境。论文提出 LingSante MedGuard，将一个医疗护栏教师模型和六个专项医疗能力专家的监督信号整合到统一模型中。前者指导模型识别和解释医疗安全、合规与伦理风险，后者分别提供医疗规则理解、数值推理、多模态幻觉检测、智能体安全核验、风险定位和多模态实体理解方面的监督。训练先使用教师生成的示范进行离线监督微调，再依据多个教师对学生模型自身生成回答的反馈进行同策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）。论文同时发布包含 11 个风险检测子集的 LingSante MedGuardBench，4B、9B 和 27B 模型的平均 F1 分别为 82.3%、82.4% 和 87.4%。在启用检索的评测中，4B 模型在 MedHallu 和 MedHALT-NOTA 上的平均准确率为 73.9%。附加评测显示，不同规模的模型在结论与证据的一致性、来源可追溯性和依据规则给出解释的质量上均有改善。
key_points_zh: 统一护栏覆盖医疗安全、合规与伦理，由护栏教师指导风险判定与解释，六个专项专家补充规则理解、数值推理和多模态核验等能力。
采用两阶段训练：先用教师示范做离线监督微调，再由多个教师评价学生模型生成的回答，进行同策略蒸馏。
LingSante MedGuardBench 包含 11 个风险检测子集；4B、9B 和 27B 模型的平均 F1 分别为 82.3%、82.4% 和 87.4%。
启用检索时，4B 模型在 MedHallu 和 MedHALT-NOTA 上的平均准确率为 73.9%；附加评测还显示证据一致性、来源可追溯性和规则解释质量有所改善。
